label: adjusted close at t+20 divided by adjusted close at t+1 minus one (class target)
selection_metric: validation RMSE, with label end strictly before test_start
portfolio: Top 10 stocks, equal weighted, signaled at first trading-day close each month; execute at next trading-day close and hold until next monthly execution. Same rule for both models.
rule: Select model using 2023 only. Refit selected settings on available 2022-2023 labels. Do not retune using 2024-2025 results. Purge all labels crossing a split boundary.
